target_customer: Security teams at companies that keep security logs in data lakes such as Snowflake, S3 and Databricks
problem: Security data grows fast and is hard to ingest, normalise and route into modern data stores without custom pipeline work.
business_model: B2B SaaS data pipeline, subscription or usage based

founders.name: Sunny Rekhi
founders.background_notes: Infrastructure and backend engineer on high scale data systems.

founders.name: Manny Gundampalli
founders.background_notes: Data infrastructure engineer on Plaid's highest volume ML pipelines. A 2024 round announced Barrett Lyon as a new CTO to lead the core ETL product.

competitors.name: Cribl
competitors.what: Observability and security data routing (Cribl Stream)

technical_complexity.rationale: Normalising logs from many SaaS and cloud sources into a common schema and routing them reliably is standard data engineering with hard parts at scale for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Parsers and schemas could be copied, though connectors and pipeline configuration create some lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cribl grew into a security pipeline leader and over 30 vendors now offer pipelines; Tarsal sold to Monad in July 2025 rather than scaling alone.

market_need_then: The company's pitch said security data was growing about 25% a year and security teams lacked pipelines built for data lakes; Tarsal joined the Snowflake partner network in 2023 (per a PR Newswire release listed in search results).

branding.domain_note: Used tarsal.co; the domain no longer resolves from this environment.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and category building (it described pioneering the modern security data stack).

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself; coverage was about funding and the acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Tarsal built a security data pipeline founded by engineers from TikTok, Uber and Plaid, raised a 6M seed in March 2024 and added a security veteran as CTO, then sold to the competitor Monad in July 2025 for undisclosed terms. It stayed seed stage in a crowded pipeline market led by Cribl, and the sale looks like consolidation rather than a breakout.
notes: Seed 6M confirmed by SecurityWeek and DBTA plus several wire copies. Earlier pre-seed or YC money amounts not found. Acquisition date 21 July 2025 per one source, September 2025 on another listing. Cribl entry is dated by its 2019 product launch, from a 2025 analyst article; other competitor lists were undated.
